info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Product Management Discount Pricings-spec
info.description: The Product Management Discount Pricing API allows users to access and retrieve a comprehensive list of discount pricing information for various products. This endpoint serves as a vital resource for financial institutions and product managers to analyze and implement competitive pricing strategies. It facilitates decision-making regarding pricing adjustments and promotional offerings by providing detailed data related to discount pricing schemes. Typical consumers include banking application developers and product management teams seeking to optimize their product pricing structures.

get.summary: Retrieve discount pricing information for products.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to access the current discount pricing available for various products in the system. It provides detailed information on discounts that can be applied, enabling informed pricing strategies.
